description: Données Ouvertes sur le Réseau Téléphonique Enterré - Bornes et Points de Raccordement - Moov au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de l'Éfficacité du Service Public et de la Transformation Numérique. Ces données détaillent les bornes et les points de raccordement du réseau téléphonique enterré de l'opérateur Moov au Togo. Elles incluent des informations sur la localisation de ces points, leur capacité de transmission, et leur état général. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de l'Éfficacité du Service Public et de la Transformation Numérique. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-05-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
